items.rationale: Section 7.1.10 preserves loss assessment cover under 5.2.6(b) even though the resulting moisture damage is excluded. A routine inspection is estimated at €300 gross, below the €3,000 event limit.

items.description: Indoor leak detection with technician and vehicle
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.10 and 5.2.6(a) cover locating the porous pipe sections, including technician time. Estimated detection of €375 gross plus one €75 gross vehicle charge is within the respective €1,000 and €83.30 gross limits.

items.description: Floor and skirting removal, screed preparation and disposal
items.rationale: Section 7.1.10 excludes removal, preparation and disposal for moisture damage from gradual porosity. The lump sum does not identify any work limited to accessing and repairing the leaking pipe sections.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes crew provisioning as contractor overhead, so none of the three units is payable.
Section 7.1.10 excludes remediation of moisture damage caused by gradual pipe ageing. None of the lump sum for drying, associated labour, dust protection or disinfection is payable.
Section 7.1.10 excludes the underlying drying, and 7.1.7(b) independently bars separate electricity charges added to a lump-sum drying rate. None of the 2,412.1 kWh is payable.
